stories.title: Boegbeeld van Spaanse woningprotesten Maricarmen Abascal (87) overleden

en.title: Maricarmen Abascal (87), figurehead of Spanish housing protests, deceased
en.summary: Maricarmen Abascal, an 87-year-old woman whose eviction sparked major housing protests in Spain, has died. Her case highlighted the country's severe housing crisis driven by inflation and insufficient affordable housing.

stories.title: Maricarmen (87), de vrouw die het symbool werd van de Spaanse wooncrisis, overleden

en.title: Maricarmen (87), the woman who became the symbol of Spain's housing crisis, deceased
en.summary: An 87-year-old woman whose eviction became emblematic of Spain's housing crisis has passed away.

stories.title: Messi eert Maradona na afscheid Argentinië, Ronaldo reageert met 'dikke knuffel'

en.title: Messi honors Maradona following Argentina farewell, Ronaldo responds with 'big hug'
en.summary: Lionel Messi paid tribute to Diego Maradona on Instagram following his farewell to the Argentine national team. Cristiano Ronaldo was among prominent figures who responded to Messi's post.

stories.title: Spaanse vrouw (87) overleden die huis uit moest en politieke crisis ontketende

en.title: Spanish woman (87) deceased who was evicted and sparked political crisis
en.summary: Maricarmen Abascal, whose eviction recently triggered a major political crisis in Spain, has died at age 87. Her case drew widespread attention to the country's housing affordability challenges.

stories.title: Nieuw-Lekkerland op veel plekken beklad met hakenkruis in vlag Israël

en.title: Nieuw-Lekkerland defaced with swastikas in multiple locations
en.summary: Dozens of locations in Nieuw-Lekkerland, South Holland, have been vandalized with swastikas superimposed on Israeli flags painted with spray paint. The municipality has filed a report and is removing the graffiti.

stories.title: De mislukte executie van Christa Pike is in elk opzicht uniek, maar de vraag blijft waarom het misging

en.title: The failed execution of Christa Pike is unique in every respect, but the question remains why it went wrong
en.summary: An execution of Christa Pike failed in unusual circumstances, raising questions about what caused the failure.

stories.title: Politie in Beieren op zoek naar een poema of iets wat daarop lijkt

en.title: Police in Bavaria search for a cougar or something resembling one
en.summary: A community near Munich airport in Bavaria has launched a major search operation involving helicopters and drones after a wild feline animal resembling a cougar was spotted by a hunter using night vision equipment.

stories.title: Bij executie Pike kon van alles misgaan, maar dat weten Amerikanen al lang

en.title: Execution of Pike could have gone wrong in many ways, but Americans have known this for a long time
en.summary: A failed execution of Christa Pike in the United States raises questions about capital punishment and lethal injection as an execution method. The substance used is not officially classified as a lethal agent.

stories.title: Tweede Kamer voor alcoholmeter bij veroordeelden

en.title: Second Chamber supports alcohol monitor for convicted offenders
en.summary: A parliamentary majority backs introducing an alcohol monitoring ankle bracelet for people convicted of crimes involving alcohol who have received alcohol bans from courts. The device detects alcohol in sweat and skin moisture, alerting probation services to violations.

stories.title: Kamer zet sein op groen voor alcoholmeter: permanente controle via enkelband

en.title: Chamber gives green light for alcohol monitor: permanent surveillance via ankle bracelet
en.summary: Parliament has approved the introduction of alcohol monitoring ankle bracelets for ongoing supervision of convicted offenders subject to alcohol restrictions.
